task: Add a new module src/slugify.mjs exporting a named function slugify(text) that turns arbitrary text into a URL slug: lowercase the input, treat every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits as a single hyphen, strip leading and trailing hyphens, and return an empty string for input with no letters or digits. For example slugify('  Rock & Roll!  ') returns 'rock-roll'. Add a test for the new module and verify with the repository test suite.
